name: knowledge-base-miner
title: Knowledge Base Miner
description: Turn help centers and FAQ pages into clean question-answer pairs using FAQPage and HowTo structured data - training data for support chatbots, AI agents and self-service knowledge bases.

input.title: Input schema for Pry Knowledge Base Miner
input.description: Turn help centers and FAQ pages into clean question-answer pairs using FAQPage and HowTo structured data - training data for support chatbots, AI agents and self-service knowledge bases.

urls.title: Target URLs
urls.description: One or more https:// URLs to process.

max_pages.title: Max pages
max_pages.description: Hard cap on processed pages (runaway protection).

min_answer_chars.title: Minimum answer length
min_answer_chars.description: Skip answers shorter than this many characters.

max_items.title: Max items (cost cap)
max_items.description: Hard cap on processed items for this run - keeps trial costs predictable. Billing stops when the cap or your spending limit is reached.

proxy_configuration.title: Proxy configuration
proxy_configuration.description: Apify proxy settings passed through to Pry's premium-proxy tier. Leave default to use the platform proxy automatically.
